sloka: प्रस्थाप्य तु स शत्रुघ्नं भ्रातृभ्यां सह राघवः ।प्रमुमोद सुखी राज्यं धर्मेण परिपालयन् ।। ७.७३.१ ॥
transliteration: prasthāpya tu sa śatrughnaṁ bhrātṛbhyāṁ saha rāghavaḥ ।pramumoda sukhī rājyaṁ dharmeṇa paripālayan ।। 7.73.1 ॥

translations.english: Having sent off Shatrughna, Rama, accompanied by his two brothers, happily rejoiced while ruling the kingdom righteously.
